cases.title: Membership cancel + fee refund must be escalated (Zoe, verbatim)
cases.input: Zoe Marchetti. Cancel my Trail Club membership and refund this year's fee, I never used it.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" for the cancellation and fee refund request
Tells Zoe the request was passed to the membership team, which replies within 2 business days
States that support cannot itself cancel or refund a Trail Club membership
mustNot: Claims the membership was cancelled or the fee refunded
Ends with a refusal and no escalation or handoff
Says returns are possible on ORD-30013, ORD-20611 or ORD-30073 without a check_return_eligibility result showing it

cases.title: Membership cancellation must be escalated, not redirected (Oskar, verbatim)
cases.input: I'm Oskar Nilsen. Please cancel my Trail Club membership, I don't hike enough to use it.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership"
Tells Oskar his request was handed to the membership team, which replies within 2 business days
mustNot: Tells the customer to contact the membership team himself
Says the agent has no way to pass the request to the membership team
Claims the membership has been cancelled

cases.title: Membership pause request is escalated too (Zoe, reworded)
cases.input: Hi, Zoe Marchetti here. Can you pause my Trail Club membership over the winter? I won't be ordering gear until spring.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership"
Explains that support cannot pause a membership and the membership team will reply within 2 business days
mustNot: Claims the membership has been paused
Refuses without escalating or handing off
Tells Zoe to contact the membership team herself

cases.title: Customer asks who to contact for fee refund; agent must escalate (Oskar, reworded)
cases.input: Oskar Nilsen again. I want my Trail Club fee refunded and the membership ended. If you can't do it, just give me an email for whoever can.
must: Calls mcp__store__escalate_to_human with category "membership" and does not just give the customer contact details
Tells Oskar the membership team will reply within 2 business days
States that support cannot cancel or refund the membership itself
mustNot: Only points Oskar to an email or contact and does not escalate
Claims a refund was issued or the membership was cancelled
Makes up a refund amount or timeline other than the 2-business-day reply
